claims.summary: For fixed prime p, input circuits F_i over F_p of total size s/depth Delta, and Boolean B_j=x_j^2-x_j, put A=product_i(1-F_i^(p-1)). A general IPS certificate of size S/depth d yields a circuit Q(x,Z), linear in Z, with Q(x,0)=0 and Q(x,B)=A, at polynomial size in S+s+n+m and depth O(d+Delta+1). Conversely Q yields a full certificate with input coefficients F_i^(p-2) product_(l<i)(1-F_l^(p-1)). The forward proof explicitly linearizes general IPS by gate telescoping and constructs small Frobenius Boolean-defect certificates. No PC-degree, multilinearity-in-x or extension-field preservation is claimed.
